action_items: FIX ORA panel raw tool-call leak (routers/chat.py ~lines 1646-1708, ora branch). Root cause hypothesis: GLM-5.2 is being given a system prompt that mentions tools (or that this branch shares the orchestrator's tool registry advert) but the ora branch in chat.py calls _call_glm() directly with NO tool dispatch — so when GLM decides to emit a tool-call (XML-style <tool_call> tags), those tags are streamed to the client verbatim instead of being parsed/executed. Two viable fixes: (a) strip `<tool_call>...</tool_call>` and any `<arg_value>` substrings from the ORA system prompt and add an explicit R6 rule 'NEVER emit <tool_call> syntax — you have no tool access in this panel; answer from given context OR ask a clarifying question'; (b) wire the ora branch through chat_with_tools() so tool calls actually execute. Also investigate the DUPLICATED stream (same 260-char block appears twice) — likely a retry or fall-through emission bug in the ora branch.

FIX fetch_url/read_url tool dispatch when prompt contains an explicit https:// URL with verb 'Read' or 'Fetch'. Current orchestrator (services/orchestrator.py) is not classifying the prompt as needing fetch_url even with the URL in the message. Either (a) add a heuristic: if prompt contains `https?://[^\s]+` AND verb in {read, fetch, summarise, summarize}, force-call fetch_url, or (b) tighten the tool-selection system prompt to mandate fetch_url for any URL-bearing prompt. Without this, founder gets hallucinated-from-pretraining replies for explicit URL fetches.

Confirm Iter 212m-22 R5 fix has actually deployed to prod — preview env passed all 9 R5 tests last iteration (100%), but prod ora panel is exhibiting the exact 'one-line preamble + dead-end' shape R5 was supposed to ban. Check git SHA on prod build (health endpoint reports build_hash=m1c5459a) vs preview build hash to confirm 212m-22 is live.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG-1 (ORA <tool_call> leak on prod): routers/chat.py ora branch calls _call_glm() directly with no tool execution loop. GLM-5.2 sees a system prompt that either advertises tool names or includes XML examples and decides to emit `<tool_call>list_repo_files:path=*<tool_call>read_repo_files:paths=[...]</arg_value>` as part of its 'plan'. Because the ora branch does not parse-and-drop or parse-and-execute these tags, they stream verbatim to the client. The duplicated content (same 260-char block twice) suggests the branch may also be invoking _call_glm twice (retry?) and concatenating both replies. citation_guard_triggered=true confirms the system noticed but did not strip the bad text. Reproduction: prompt 'What is the main architecture of this project?' with agent='ora' + dogfood project_id. Mitigation: (i) immediate — add regex strip `<tool_call[^>]*>.*?(</tool_call>|<tool_call|</arg_value>)` over the streamed content in the ora branch BEFORE token-frame emission; (ii) proper — wire ora through chat_with_tools() so the tool calls actually execute, then return both the synthesised reply AND a verified_paths list. BUG-2 (fetch_url not firing): orchestrator's tool selector does not treat an explicit URL+verb prompt as a force-fetch trigger. Reply is plausible-from-pretraining (e.g. correct FastAPI tagline) so easily missed in casual testing, but web_sources=[] and tool_invocations=[] in the done frame are the smoking gun. Mitigation: add a forced-tool rule in services/orchestrator.py: if prompt regex matches `(read|fetch|summari[sz]e|open|visit)\s+.{0,40}https?://`, mandate fetch_url(url) before LLM call.
